{{Quote|You're not going to throw up, are you? I just cleaned this crate.|Sicko, to [[Fi Skirata]]|<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>}}
'''Sicko''', known by the [[Cloning|clone]] number of '''CT-1127/549''', was the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Traffic Interdiction Vessel|TIV]] used by [[Omega Squad]] when they were assigned to capture a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Gizer L-6 freighter]] during a [[Traffic Interdiction Operations|TIOPS]] [[Mission to the Corellian-Perlemian Intersection|mission]] at the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian]]&ndash;[[Perlemian node|Perlemian]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] intersection in the [[Tynna sector/Legends|Tynna sector]].

Sicko was the only casualty sustained by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the mission when [[TIV Z590/1|his craft]] was fired upon and sent spinning into interstellar void by the civilian [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Nova Crystal (starship)|''Nova Crystal'']]. His remains were retrieved by the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] [[Majestic (Acclamator-class)|''Majestic'']], 367 days after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]. Due to the black ops nature of the mission, the true identity of the vessel was never released and, under the impression that he had fired on a pirate vessel, ''Nova Crystal''{{'s}} skipper was lauded a hero. Sicko's death would have a lasting impact on the members of Omega Squad.

Sicko got his name from the fact that his piloting style combined with the lack of [[Antigrav/Legends|antigrav]] on TIVs often caused his passengers to throw up.
